summary: Execution is allowed. No blocking implementation, extraction or provenance defect was found. L01-L03 accurately represent the approved main article and embedded author-response table, including the pooled-sex, age/gender-adjusted BMI>30 coefficient -0.33 mg/dL per BMI unit and its source CI. The final generator uses that coefficient as the local right derivative of its disclosed exponential continuation, replacing the initial longitudinal percentage slopes. Seven other parameter groups and the original source records are unchanged. Independent invented-input checks passed, and initial/final commitments plus gateway history prefixes remain intact. This is a scientific and numerical revision with additional measurement/uncertainty qualification; target accuracy or improvement is unevaluated.

change_classification.measurement_related: Additional source measurement context and explicit lack of assay calibration; no numerical measurement correction.
change_classification.description: The sole numerical parameter-group replacement is tail_log_slopes (sex-specific longitudinal percent changes) -> tail_additive_slope (-0.33 from the source's cross-sectional BMI>30 regression). Code changes the exponential rate to beta/m0, making the local additive right derivative beta. Mean anchors, BMI/age knots, age contrasts/counts, SEMs and cell counts are preserved. F2/F3 retention is accompanied by qualifications and sensitivity analyses, not an inferred improvement.

initial_finding_disposition.disposition: Addressed the longitudinal-versus-cross-sectional estimand mismatch by adding directly relevant cross-sectional evidence. Population transport and the chosen exponential curvature remain unresolved.
Retained numerical anchor/age construction with explicit justification and representative-knot/age sensitivities. Missing within-bin and sex-age-BMI distributions remain an identification gap.

Retained conditional variability proxy with explicit qualification and spread/family sensitivities. Correctly kept new overall SD and assay description contextual; neither was mislabeled as conditional residual spread or assay equivalence.

findings.evidence_location: final/evidence.json L01-L03; final/model_spec.json A01/A07, tail_additive_slope and equations; approved d4171b258e7d1d5e65496e1b0f20e80dc8f19265abed96730afa705ad6728299.xml and b2ee68e3163d9d8ad18df363ac332724afec410a690bdd9d7d386b5856e5bfd2.txt, main Table 2 and embedded Author response Table rev2
findings.issue: The newly selected coefficient is a correctly extracted cross-sectional linear coefficient in a selected, medication-free Italian clinic subgroup. It does not identify a derivative specifically at BMI 30.5, sex-specific slopes, exponential curvature or behavior beyond the source BMI support. Treating it as the local derivative is explicitly assumed. The numerical local-derivative implementation is correct; the remaining limitation is scientific transport and shape identification, not an execution bug.
findings.suggested_action: Preserve the documented population, adjustment, correspondence-table provenance and curvature qualifications in evaluation/reporting. No further optimization turn or frozen-candidate edit is requested.

findings.evidence_location: final/evidence.json G01/G03/G04; final/model_spec.json A02/A03/A06; final/decision.md Review F2
findings.issue: The revision does not identify exact-BMI conditional means or the missing sex-by-age-by-BMI source mixtures. The source-age centering identity remains valid only at assumed discrete representatives, and adjusted source age contrasts remain a provisional bridge to the reduced predictor set. The final decision accurately acknowledges this and does not claim its sensitivities resolve it.
findings.suggested_action: Retain this unresolved limitation when interpreting individual conditional associations. Treat the sensitivity checks as model consequences, not evidence selecting the retained structure; no further candidate change is requested.

findings.evidence_location: final/evidence.json G02/L03; final/model_spec.json A04/A05/A08; final/decision.md Review F3
findings.issue: The lognormal arithmetic and SEM-to-SD conversion are correct, but broad-cell source SD remains a conditional-variability proxy. L03 is an overall mean/SD and assay description; it supplies neither conditional residual SD nor target measurement calibration. The final model keeps source/transport uncertainty separate from residual random draws, and its illustrative variance/family sensitivities do not provide uncertainty coverage.
findings.suggested_action: Keep these uncertainty and measurement qualifications attached to analytical-utility claims. No implementation repair or further optimization is required for execution.

documentation_note: One retained sentence in final/model_spec.json alternatives_considered still calls the selected tail 'longitudinal'. The following alternative, parameter provenance, equations, A07, code, decision and revision record consistently identify the cross-sectional replacement. This is stale historical wording, not an ambiguous numerical implementation or an execution blocker; frozen artifacts were not edited.
tests: Read final generator before import and ran loop_control.source_check successfully. Static AST review is not a sandbox or a proof of no side effects.
Validated 8 parameter provenance groups and 10 evidence records. Verified all 15 final commitment entries and all 9 source-artifact paths/hashes against own accepted gateway registrations.
Verified all 12 initial commitment entries, all four initial-review binding hashes, and both initial/final gateway audit-history prefixes. No broader run commitment or participant CSV was read.

Independently checked approved L2020 XML Table 2 HDL/BMI coefficient -0.42, CI [-0.53,-0.32]; embedded author-response Table rev2 BMI>30 coefficient -0.33, CI [-0.47,-0.20], p<0.001 and age/gender adjustment; Table 1 HDL 48.35 +/- 12.47 mg/dL and range 19-116; overnight fasting and plasma lipid automated colorimetry. Verified L01-L03 ledger values and source units/context.

Rechecked retained G2019 source cells/counts/age contrasts directly from approved XML, SEM-to-SD arithmetic and assumed source-age centering. Seven non-tail parameter groups exactly match initial; all original source records are preserved.

Six invented rows: exact observed fields/order/index preservation, no input/specification mutation, no global RNG mutation on import or generation, same-seed equality, different-seed variation. Empty input succeeds; invalid sex, zero/NaN BMI and infinite age are rejected.
Independent scalar reference on 120 invented predictor combinations (BMI 13-80, ages 20-79) agrees within 1.12e-15 relative error; all values finite and positive.

Six invented fixed-predictor cells with 120000 draws each meet mean-within-6-MC-SE and SD-within-2.5% criteria. Largest absolute mean discrepancy was 2.967 MC SE; largest relative SD discrepancy was 0.002890.

Paired same-seed initial/final comparison: all 96 grid rows at/below BMI 30.5 are bit-identical; 24 rows above it change, with maximum absolute relative draw change 0.1098402. This establishes a substantive behavioral change only, not improvement.

Measured local tail derivatives through paired candidate calls at invented ages 20,50,79 for both sexes; estimates range from -0.3299998940 to -0.3299998720 and agree with -0.33 within 2e-7. This is local slope matching, not validation of exponential curvature.
Recomputed final-versus-flat tail ratios at invented BMI 80 and age 50: male 0.6871034, female 0.7274707; no preferred target value inferred.

Reproducible review harness and results: final_review_checks.py and final_review_checks.json. One preliminary harness read failed under Windows' default text encoding; the reviewer harness was corrected to read the approved text as UTF-8, then all checks passed. Frozen candidates were unchanged.
review_scope: Own approved evidence, initial/final candidate files and artificial inputs only; no real outcomes, observed participant rows, participant outputs, other runs, target results or external retrieval. Final source/code verification only; no new scientific optimization round.
quality_claim: Source/execution verification only. All target-quality and improvement claims remain unevaluated.
